facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Economy, Digitalization and Innovation has a 2026 budget of 82 billion CFA francs, presented by the minister to the National Transition Assembly.
facts.system: Ministry of Digital Economy, Digitalization and Innovation budget 2026

facts.fact: The digital ministry's budget rises from 32 billion CFA francs in 2025 to 82 billion in 2026, an increase of 156.2%.
